title: agropyron repens var. glaucum
intro: Agropyron repens var. glaucum, commonly known as creeping bentgrass, is a perennial grass native to Eurasia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of A. repens var. glaucum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of A. repens var. glaucum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
